name: Niulai
_comment: Trims are read off docs/clips/contact-sheet.png. The Meshy exports are whole performances — the punch is four seconds of standing in a guard stance with the punch in the middle of it — so each state names the slice worth playing. Speeds are not set here: the game's timings below decide how fast a slice plays, so the animation and the rules cannot disagree about when contact happens.
_spares: walk, hurdle and backjump are merged and trimmed but not bound to anything yet. jump needs an air state before it is worth wiring; knee is an obvious heavy attack.
